panel: same retained training examples and all ordinary development examples as parent; complete 2-second branch targets only
continuous: independent matched dimension step-10000 seed 17 only
baseline: historical pooled background, dataset and position with visible X RMS cut points [0.5,1,2]; global training fallback
primary: relative MSE gain vs background for original categorical, shrunk categorical and subject-balanced shrunk categorical
secondary: identical background-residual standardized linear ridge probes of independent continuous z, hard encoder z and retained integer codebook entry; direct attributes of the two decoded outputs
null: no lower held-out MSE than the corresponding training background
aggregation: mean over feature coordinates, valid patches, positions, crops, records, subjects and datasets successively
selection: dataset-stratified three folds of sorted training subjects round robin; minimize MSE per attribute with people equal within dataset and datasets equal; ties choose first
balanced: average person-specific means within each cell and background; shrink joint toward balanced background with distinct people as effective count
stopping: all frozen models and complete development panel; no tokenizer updates; keep failures and missing support
